# Exact

> Exact is a way to write an app once and ship it natively to the web, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows and Android. The view is Contract (`app.contract`): HTML's structure and CSS's names in an indented syntax, with TypeScript's expressions. Data lives in a TypeScript module (`app.ts`). Each host draws its own controls, so an app says what a thing is and leaves colour, type, bars and motion to the platform. A coding agent can build, run, see and test the app on every host from the command line.

Exact has no releases, tags or npm package. An app uses a checkout of https://github.com/expo/exact by path, and the paths below are relative to that checkout. Make an app with `bun scripts/exact.mjs new <path>` (run `bun scripts/exact.mjs setup` once first), then work in the app's directory with `bun exact.mjs <verb>`.

Rules that differ from React and React Native:

- Read one start guide whole, then look things up by name. `bun exact.mjs contract vocab <name>…` answers any tag, function, property, idiom or recipe; `bun exact.mjs docs <heading words>` prints one section of a guide.
- Start from the nearest tested pattern: `bun exact.mjs pattern` lists them.
- Write structure and layout; leave controls unpainted. A colour names a role (`-exact-secondary-label`), not a hex.
- Every screen, tab and sheet is a route. Only the root component declares `resource`, `mutation` and `task`.
- Contract has no `null`, truthiness, indexing, spread or JSX callbacks: absence is an option to `match`, lists copy with `concat`, records with `Shape(old, field=value)`, repetition is a keyed `for`.
- A data source answers exactly its declared shape. A failed read throws; a refused write returns a shaped reply. `app.ts` has no clock or randomness.
- Verify by running: `bun exact.mjs contract build app.contract --json` prints `[]` on success, `bun exact.mjs verify` tests, checks layouts and relaunches. A web pass does not establish native behaviour.

- [Building an app](docs/start-here.md): the only required reading for an app: the idea, the workflow, one complete screen with its data module and test, the costliest pitfalls
- [Building a website](docs/start-here-site.md): the only required reading for a site: pages at URLs, rendered ahead or per request
- [The card](docs/card.md): every function, tag, part, test step and idiom on one page; `contract vocab` prints the same text

## Skills

- [exact-app](skills/exact-app/SKILL.md): building or changing an Exact app: where work belongs, Contract against JSX habits, the build, test and verify loop
- [exact-performance](skills/exact-performance/SKILL.md): measuring with `perf`, long lists, work at rest, data-source budgets, launch
- [exact-desktop](skills/exact-desktop/SKILL.md): a Mac app that embeds a web guest, a companion service, native pickers, a full-window title bar, shortcuts, packaging

To use a skill in Claude Code, link its directory into `~/.claude/skills/` or the app's `.claude/skills/`.

## Recipes

One short file per common question, each with code that compiles. `contract vocab <name>` prints one.

- [list-rows](docs/recipes/list-rows.md): a list with search, swipe to delete and a long-press menu
- [grouped-form](docs/recipes/grouped-form.md): an entry or settings form
- [navigation-stack](docs/recipes/navigation-stack.md): routes, push, back, sheets
- [tabs](docs/recipes/tabs.md): tabs with a stack in each
- [fetch-loading-error](docs/recipes/fetch-loading-error.md): loading, failure, retry, pull to refresh
- [rest-backend](docs/recipes/rest-backend.md): a server of your own, its origin as a setting, HTTP caching
- [after-a-write](docs/recipes/after-a-write.md): a write that may be refused
- [files-and-grants](docs/recipes/files-and-grants.md): records kept across launches: a JSON file, SQLite, picked documents
- [persisted-setting](docs/recipes/persisted-setting.md): a setting kept with `persist`
- [timers](docs/recipes/timers.md): tasks, `every` and `after`, a timer that measures time
- [dates-and-days](docs/recipes/dates-and-days.md): the date, days, pinned clocks in tests
- [motion](docs/recipes/motion.md): transitions, keyframes, exit and layout animation
- [theme](docs/recipes/theme.md) and [tamber](docs/recipes/tamber.md): brand colours, light and dark, design tokens
- [symbols](docs/recipes/symbols.md): icons by role
- [responsive-columns](docs/recipes/responsive-columns.md): one column on a phone, two when wide
- [chat-thread](docs/recipes/chat-thread.md): a transcript that opens at its newest message
- [native-module](docs/recipes/native-module.md): a Swift module the data module asks
- [native-views](docs/recipes/native-views.md): a map, the camera, a platform view
- [permissions](docs/recipes/permissions.md): location and anything the person must allow
- [app-json](docs/recipes/app-json.md): manifest keys, assets, the modules folder
- [tests](docs/recipes/tests.md): authored tests and their steps
- [ios-driving](docs/recipes/ios-driving.md): driving the app on a simulator
- [website](docs/recipes/website.md): serving a site, per-request pages, settings, deep links
- [porting-and-release](docs/recipes/porting-and-release.md): porting an app, a release build

## Lookup

Read these by section, never front to back.

- [Contract for agents](docs/contract-for-agents.md): the working guide: values and expressions, state and actions, data requests, views and layout, routes, tabs, time and motion, inspection and testing, repairing common mistakes
- [Pitfalls](docs/agent-pitfalls.md): verified footguns, by area: layout, lists and scrolling, native navigation, porting from React Native, actions, input, driving and testing, websites
- [Grammar](docs/contract-grammar.md): exact syntax, lengths, authored-test forms
- [Reference](docs/reference.md): the data module's runtime (fetch, storage, budgets, sockets), access hatches, painters, delivery
- [Testing](docs/testing.md): waits, isolation, coverage, measuring
- [Game pitfalls](docs/game-pitfalls.md): for a game made with `exact new <path> --game`

## Examples

- [apps/shelf](apps/shelf/app.contract): a whole app to grep
- [apps/metronome](apps/metronome/app.contract): sound, MIDI and a transport with no native audio code
- [Exact Draw](https://github.com/rami-maalouf/exact-draw): a Mac app outside this repository: a native shell around an embedded Excalidraw editor and a local file service, with a journal of what building on Exact was like
